title: feat(app-shell): extend runtime persistence seam to record 'page' (#1541)
body:
## Why

First step of #1541 (record-page runtime persistence, ADR-0034). The draft→publish seam (`runtime-metadata-persistence.ts`) only handled `view`/`report`/`dashboard`; record pages had no persistence path. This adds the foundation the edit loop builds on.

## What

- `RuntimeArtifactType` += `'page'` — a record `PageSchema` now stages/publishes through the same `metadataClient` draft model (the client is type-generic; `/meta/page/:name` already exists, no backend change).
- Pure helper **`recordPageName(objectName, existing?)`** — prefers an already-assigned record page's name, else mints `<object>_record` (so first-edit of the synthesized default has a stable key to draft/version against).
- Pure helper **`recordPageEnvelope(objectName, schema, name?)`** — stamps the `name` / `object` / `pageType:'record'` / `kind:'full'` identity fields `usePageAssignment` matches on, so a published page overrides the synthesized default on the next render.

## Verification

- Unit: 15 seam tests (page persist/read-draft/publish round-trip; helper naming + envelope identity fields).

Next: PR2 wires the RecordDetailView edit entry → persist draft + `RuntimeDraftBar` + draft overlay; PR3 the live e2e round-trip + docs.
